Good morning, Freddy. Thank you for the information. Our procedure is to bring the pallet to the line, remove the label, and have the leader enter it into the system with the label in hand. Once entered, we complete and sign the log and fill out the label placed on the pallet as confirmation. We only enter pallets when they are physically at the line, not while they are in staging. Is it possible that two pallets could have the same LPN? We will continue making sure the proper procedure is always followed.

Good morning team, this is what the plan I came out with:

We will add the same amount of coconut oil required for a 30 minute production run into the tank and allow it to mix for 30 minutes to ensure proper incorporation.

After mixing, we will deposit chocolate for 1 minute and collect a sample of the chocolate center to perform an organoleptic evaluation.

We will document the results and repeat the evaluation as needed until the chocolate center passes the organoleptic test.

Any chocolate that does not meet the required chocolate to coconut oil ratio or fails the organoleptic evaluation will be scrapped and will not be released for production.

Rose Smuin, Preston Tregaskis
